summary: This document specifies a method to find which Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP) server is authoritative for a requested scope, such as domain names, IP addresses, or Autonomous System numbers. It was replaced by RFC 9224.

eli5.summary: There are many registries, and you need to know which one to ask. This describes a directory that points you to the right one. It was replaced by RFC 9224.

questions: how to find the right rdap server
